text:
Consider, fair Glover, once my pupil, and Blanche the Shoemaker, that you must learn to live. Take left and right—God sent each passing man—for an old woman is discarded like a coin no longer current.

And you, lovely Sausage Seller whose dancing banishes sleep, and Guillemette the Tapestry Maker: satisfy the master's whims! Soon this time will be far away, you will be ugly as owls, of no use even to old priests, like a coin no longer current.

You, Jeannette the Hatmaker: let no love detain you; you, Catherine the Pursemaker: scorn no man who comes; though, remembering myself, I sometimes smile and urge them on, I know no one will take me, like a coin no longer current.

Know, girls, that if I burst into such sad, abundant tears, it is because I find no one to seek me, like a coin no longer current.

translation.title: Ballad of the Fair Armorer to the Young Courtesans
